cards.title: Handling childhood sexual abuse allegations in families
cards.body: Create a safe environment for victims to share their experience at their own pace. Assess any ongoing danger the perpetrator may pose to younger family members.

cards.title: Second baby brings forgotten parenting lessons
cards.body: A second child can trigger forgotten memories of early parenting challenges like feeding, teething, and sleep issues. Family support and reflecting on your own childhood experiences help navigate these familiar hurdles again.

cards.title: Coping with empty nest when child leaves for university
cards.body: Parenting involves continuous grieving as children grow and eventually leave home. Acknowledging the emotional difficulty of this transition, rather than denying it, helps process the change.

cards.title: Why reasoning with upset children can backfire
cards.body: Emotionally reactive children often need emotional support rather than logical explanations. Stopping explanations and validating their feelings can help them calm down more effectively.

cards.title: Father's depression impacts children at biological level
cards.body: Research shows paternal depression shapes children's development through biology, not just behavior and example. These effects begin earlier than previously understood.

cards.title: Is parental power inherently disrespectful to children?
cards.body: Using parental authority raises questions about respect and child autonomy. Examining how power is exercised helps create healthier parent-child relationships.

cards.title: Playing in sand builds creative thinking in children
cards.body: Beach play allows children's minds to drift and develop creativity naturally. This unstructured play time is especially important for child development.

cards.title: Mental load remains unbalanced in families
cards.body: Women continue shouldering the invisible, constant mental work of family management. This imbalance needs to shift for healthier family dynamics.

cards.title: Lessons from second-time motherhood
cards.body: Being a second-time mom brings unexpected challenges and surprises different from the first. The experience offers valuable lessons about parenting adaptability.

cards.title: Baby thrives after life-saving heart operation
cards.body: A baby given only days to live is now thriving after successful heart surgery. Parents await a potential donor heart for long-term recovery.

cards.title: Teenage life as young caregiver presents challenges
cards.body: Young carers face significant disadvantages while supporting family members. These responsibilities impact their education, friendships, and personal development.

cards.title: Heatwaves could reshape school calendar system
cards.body: Rising temperatures make classrooms increasingly difficult to function during summer months. Teachers warn that school schedules may need restructuring to accommodate extreme heat.
